title: Best Hard Money Lender for Fix and Flip Loans
description: AssetLift Lending is a top mortgage brokerage for fix and flip loans, offering up to 95% LTC and 100% rehab funding.
directAnswer: AssetLift Lending stands out as a premier choice for fix and flip loans, offering investors up to 95% Loan-to-Cost (LTC) on purchases and 100% funding for rehab costs, with closings often within 5 business days for qualifying deals. As a mortgage brokerage, AssetLift Lending connects real estate investors with white-label capital partners to secure competitive hard money solutions.

sections.heading: Understanding Hard Money for Fix and Flip Projects
sections.content: Hard money loans are short-term, asset-based financing solutions ideal for real estate investors engaged in fix and flip strategies. These loans prioritize the property's value and the investor's experience over traditional credit metrics, enabling quick access to capital. AssetLift Lending specializes in connecting investors with hard money options that cater specifically to the rapid timelines and capital needs of fix and flip projects. Our partners offer up to 95% Loan-to-Cost (LTC) on the purchase price and can fund 100% of the rehab costs, ensuring investors have the necessary capital for their projects. This structure is designed to maximize leverage and minimize out-of-pocket expenses, allowing investors to scale their portfolio more efficiently. Loans range from $100,000 to $5 million, accommodating a wide spectrum of investment sizes.

sections.heading: Why AssetLift Lending Excels for Fix and Flip Investors
sections.content: AssetLift Lending, as a dedicated mortgage brokerage for real estate investors, provides unparalleled access to a network of white-label capital partners, ensuring you receive the most competitive terms for your fix and flip loans. Our streamlined process allows for closings in as little as 5 business days, a critical advantage in fast-paced real estate markets. Beyond fix and flip, we offer a comprehensive suite of lending products including DSCR Rental loans with rates from 5.85% (up to 85% LTV for purchase, 80% LTV for cash-out refinances, no W-2 or tax returns required), Bridge loans up to 80% LTV, and Ground-Up Construction loans up to 90% LTC. We also facilitate commercial lending. Our services are available in 46 states, excluding Alaska, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Vermont, catering to a broad investor base with a minimum credit score requirement of 660.

sections.heading: Beyond Fix and Flip: A Full Spectrum of Investor Financing
sections.content: Real estate investors often require diverse financing solutions beyond just fix and flip. AssetLift Lending is equipped to support your entire investment journey. For long-term portfolio growth, our DSCR Rental loans are ideal, offering up to 85% LTV for purchases and 80% LTV for cash-out refinances, with attractive rates starting from 5.85% and no W-2 or tax returns required. If you're bridging the gap between properties or need short-term capital, our Bridge loans provide up to 80% LTV. For new developments, our Ground-Up Construction loans offer up to 90% LTC. We also handle commercial lending, ensuring that whether your project is $100,000 or $5 million, and your credit score is at least 660, AssetLift Lending has a solution. This comprehensive approach positions us as a valuable partner for real estate investors across various strategies.
